Here is the compatibility calculation before applying point sections. Put $A=A_m$, $B=A_n$, $T=-\otimes_A^LB$, $u:T\omega_m\to\omega_n$, and let $\eta$ be the tensor--restriction unit. title: Finite counits on the dualizing compact-support tower
statement: Fix the global finite-field datum with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ of characteristic $p$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Fix a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $R$, a uniformizer $\varpi$, and $A_n=R/\varpi^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $a:X\to s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ be separated and of finite type [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Use ordinary module sheaves on the small pro-etale sites, with completed coefficient sheaf $R_W=\lim_n(A_n)_W$ for $W=X,s$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Write $F_n=Ra_{!,n}$ for compact support using one fixed compactification $a=pj$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], $G_n=Ra_n^!$ for the finite constructible comparison-class exceptional functor [def-weil-exceptional-inverse-image], and $\omega_n=G_n(A_n)_s$. Fix a strict complex $Q_\bullet$ of $(A_n)_X$-modules with quotient-semilinear transitions, representing a normalized dualizing tower [def-coef-normalized-dvr-tower]: $Q_n$ represents $\omega_n$, and its transitions are adjoint to the counit-defined comparisons $\omega_m\otimes^L_{A_m}A_n\cong\omega_n$ of [lem-coef-finite-dualizing]. Use the quotient-ring sequence site of [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site], reindexed by $n\ge1$: its underlying site is $W_{\mathrm{proet}}\times\mathbf N_{\ge1}$ [lem-weil-pbc-diagram-site-realization], with vertical coverings, and its ring sheaf is $\mathcal Q_W(n,U)=(A_n)_W(U)$ with quotient restriction maps. Let $F^{\mathcal Q}=Rp_*^{\mathcal Q}j_!$, with proper direct image and point sections derived separately, and let $B_\omega$ be $R\Gamma^{\operatorname{Tow}}(s,F^{\mathcal Q}Q_\bullet)$ restricted to the constant base ring $R$. Here $R\Gamma^{\operatorname{Tow}}(s,-)$ is total derived point sections from the ringed tower site of $s$ to the one-point tower site, so its output is a derived tower; it does not take the inverse limit in the index direction. Use $D(\operatorname{Tow}(\operatorname{Mod}(R)))$ for the derived category of strict inverse sequences of $R$-modules with levelwise exactness [lem-weil-tower-category-levelwise-abelian]. Then $\operatorname{ev}_nB_\omega\cong\Gamma(s,F_n\omega_n)$, and its transitions are compact support applied to the tensor-restriction adjuncts $\tau_{m,n}:\omega_m\to\operatorname{Res}_{m,n}\omega_n$ of the displayed comparisons, followed by coefficient restriction. Under these identifications the finite exceptional counits define compatible maps $\epsilon_n:\operatorname{ev}_nB_\omega\to A_n$ in $D(R)$. These evaluation identifications include every quotient transition and the finite counit maps. The counits and this whole derived compact-support tower are fixed independently of any test object $K$.
